answer.summary: The API Types Check failed because the generated api-types.d.ts differs from the committed file. The CatalogHistory action enum gained UPDATE and ROLLBACK, but the committed types were not regenerated after the change. This is deterministic, so a retry will fail again. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the updated api-types.d.ts.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
